summary.result: The compressive strengths of lightweight polymer concretes with apparent specific gravity for 1.32 to 1.78 were 250 to 470 kfg/cm $^2$ and flexural strengths were measured to be in the range of 1/3-1/4 of compressive strength.
summary.background: Recent advance in material technology has accelerated the development of high strength concrete using lightweight artificial aggregates.
summary.method: In this study the lightweight polymer concrete using unsaturated polyester resin and lightweight aggregate were prepared and tested for testing the physical and the mechanical properties.
